fee_notes: Single franchise fee is $63,000, uniformly imposed, fully earned and nonrefundable. Two franchises at same time: $126,000. Subsequent franchises: $55,000. Additional required payments at signing: BM2000 machine $9,660, trailer/equipment/marketing/supplies $50,090, initial training $9,500, shop assistance fee $6,500.
raw_excerpt: When you sign the Franchise Agreement, you will pay us a $63,000 Initial Franchise Fee for a single BORDER MAGIC franchise, which is uniformly imposed, fully earned and nonrefundable upon payment.
